title: PTB Room Acoustics Absorption Coefficient Database overview

doi.absence_reason: The official database overview does not assign a DOI.

license.name: PTB page states the listed data can be downloaded and used as desired; no SPDX license is declared

measurement_uncertainty.description: Only the overview page was registered; material records and their measurement methods or uncertainties were not acquired.

known_gaps: The linked Excel/ZIP database was not downloaded or checksum-pinned.
PTB states that room-acoustics research and support for this legacy database have stopped.
NexusEP has no octave-band absorption, scattering, reverberation, or reflection model, so these data are scientifically mismatched to ACOUST-0.
Any future use must register the actual database version, sheets, material mapping, measurement method, uncertainty, and preprocessing.

preprocessing.description: Verify the official overview markers and checksum without downloading or using the material-property database.

permitted_use.purpose: Future source discovery for frequency-dependent material absorption and scattering models.
permitted_use.notes: No current NexusEP acoustic result may use this metadata-only record as physical validation evidence.
